author: gta6tracker
text:
10 things to do before leaving Jason’s safehouse in GTA 6!

From fixing up the bedroom and changing Jason’s appearance to feeding Dolores, working out, reading books, and fishing off the back pier, there’s plenty to explore during your first visit.

Make sure to check the shed for reading material and a heavy bag you can hang after painting the bedroom.

Bonus vehicles are available exclusively with the Ultimate Edition.

author: gta6tracker
text:
3 FREE legendary weapons you can find in GTA 6 Chapter 1! 🔫

Here’s where to get them:

• Assassin Nipper .38: Suppressed pistol hidden inside a wreck in the southeastern Permit Keys.

• Smuggler Gorse 425: Shotgun found beside a tilted boat in the northern Permit Keys.

• Kingfishers W-22: Suppressed rifle inside the main shack at Fishing Shacks in Wetman Bay. Wait for Donnie’s robbery text to access this location.

All 3 weapons are available without spending any money.

author: grok
text:
GTA 6 has multiple endings shaped by your choices, relationship stage with Lucia, criminal profile, and family savings.

In the finale, after grabbing the hard drive of dirt on the senator, cops trap you on a bridge.

Choice 1: Jump. Jason hands Lucia the drive then lets go so she escapes. He gets arrested. She takes the deal, raises their son Tomás, and visits him in prison later.

Choice 2: Fight. Both die in the shootout holding hands.

Rockstar says way more than two variants exist. After credits the game rewinds pre-finale so you can free roam or try again.

did you know you can get paid to clip GTA VI without editing a single frame?

it's called gtavi-claudecode. free, open source, runs inside claude code.

here's what it does:

→ finds who's streaming gta 6 right now
→ catches the second chat explodes
→ cuts it into a 9:16 clip with captions and a hook
→ checks it against the campaign rules
→ tells you where to post it

streamers and brands pay clippers per 1k views.

you just hit post. that’s all you need to do.
